cat > /app/solve.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np

M=0xFFFFFFFF
def rol2(t): return ((t<<2)|(t>>6))&0xFF
def ror2(v): return ((v>>2)|(v<<6))&0xFF

# scalar F / Finv (python ints)
def g(a,b,x): return rol2((a+b+x)&0xFF)
def F(inp):
    x0=inp&0xFF;x1=(inp>>8)&0xFF;x2=(inp>>16)&0xFF;x3=(inp>>24)&0xFF
    y2=g(x3^x2,x1^x0,1);y3=g(x3,y2,0);y1=g(x1^x0,y2,0);y0=g(x0,y1,1)
    return (y0|(y1<<8)|(y2<<16)|(y3<<24))&M
def Finv(out):
    y0=out&0xFF;y1=(out>>8)&0xFF;y2=(out>>16)&0xFF;y3=(out>>24)&0xFF
    x0=(ror2(y0)-y1-1)&0xFF
    x1x0=(ror2(y1)-y2)&0xFF
    x1=(x1x0^x0)&0xFF
    x3x2=(ror2(y2)-x1x0-1)&0xFF
    x3=(ror2(y3)-y2)&0xFF
    x2=(x3x2^x3)&0xFF
    return (x0|(x1<<8)|(x2<<16)|(x3<<24))&M
# self test
import random
for _ in range(10000):
    v=random.randint(0,M); assert Finv(F(v))==v
print("F/Finv ok")

def expand(k): return (k ^ ((k<<16)&M) ^ ((k*12345)&M))&M

# validate python encrypt vs binary
def encrypt(pt,K):
    L=(pt>>32)&M;R=pt&M;R^=L
    for i in range(4):
        mixed=F(R^K[i]);t=R;R=(L^mixed)&M;L=t
    L^=R
    return ((R<<32)|L)&0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
K=[expand(0x12345),expand(0xabcde),expand(0x00001),expand(0xfffff)]
assert encrypt(0x0123456789ABCDEF,K)==0xD90BBBBA143752FC, hex(encrypt(0x0123456789ABCDEF,K))
print("encrypt matches binary")

# parse pairs
pairs=[]
for line in open('/app/pairs.txt'):
    a,b=line.split(); pairs.append((int(a),int(b)))
P=np.array([p for p,_ in pairs],dtype=np.uint64)
C=np.array([c for _,c in pairs],dtype=np.uint64)
Lp=(P>>np.uint64(32)).astype(np.uint64)&np.uint64(M)
Rp=P&np.uint64(M)
B0=(Rp^Lp).astype(np.int64)          # pre-mix right
Lp_i=Lp.astype(np.int64)
CH=(C>>np.uint64(32)).astype(np.int64)&M   # ciphertext high = B4
CLo=(C&np.uint64(M)).astype(np.int64)      # low = A4^B4
B3=(CH^CLo)                                # = CR^CL = B_3 (known)
npairs=len(pairs)

# vectorized F/Finv on int64 arrays
def Fv(inp):
    x0=inp&0xFF;x1=(inp>>8)&0xFF;x2=(inp>>16)&0xFF;x3=(inp>>24)&0xFF
    def gv(a,b,x):
        t=(a+b+x)&0xFF; return ((t<<2)|(t>>6))&0xFF
    y2=gv(x3^x2,x1^x0,1);y3=gv(x3,y2,0);y1=gv(x1^x0,y2,0);y0=gv(x0,y1,1)
    return (y0|(y1<<8)|(y2<<16)|(y3<<24))
def Finvv(out):
    y0=out&0xFF;y1=(out>>8)&0xFF;y2=(out>>16)&0xFF;y3=(out>>24)&0xFF
    r=lambda v:((v>>2)|(v<<6))&0xFF
    x0=(r(y0)-y1-1)&0xFF
    x1x0=(r(y1)-y2)&0xFF
    x1=(x1x0^x0)&0xFF
    x3x2=(r(y2)-x1x0-1)&0xFF
    x3=(r(y3)-y2)&0xFF
    x2=(x3x2^x3)&0xFF
    return (x0|(x1<<8)|(x2<<16)|(x3<<24))

N=1<<20
seeds=np.arange(N,dtype=np.int64)
rk=(seeds ^ ((seeds<<16)&M) ^ ((seeds*12345)&M))&M   # expand over all seeds

PRIME=np.int64(1000000007)
# K0 side fingerprint: B1(p)=Lp ^ F(B0[p]^rk0);  sig relative pair0
F0=Fv(B0[0]^rk)               # array over seeds
B1_0=(int(Lp_i[0])^F0)
fp0=np.zeros(N,dtype=np.int64)
for p in range(1,npairs):
    Fp=Fv(B0[p]^rk)
    B1_p=(int(Lp_i[p])^Fp)
    sig=(B1_p^B1_0)&M
    fp0=(fp0*PRIME+sig)&0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
# K3 side: B2(p)=CLo[p]^F(B3[p]^rk3); u(p)=Finv(B2(p)^B0[p]); sig rel pair0
G0=Fv(B3[0]^rk); B2_0=(int(CLo[0])^G0); u0=Finvv((B2_0^int(B0[0]))&M)
fp3=np.zeros(N,dtype=np.int64)
for p in range(1,npairs):
    Gp=Fv(B3[p]^rk);B2_p=(int(CLo[p])^Gp);up=Finvv((B2_p^int(B0[p]))&M)
    sig=(up^u0)&M
    fp3=(fp3*PRIME+sig)&0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

print("fingerprints computed")
# build dict from K3 side
d={}
fp3l=fp3.tolist()
for i,v in enumerate(fp3l): d.setdefault(v,[]).append(i)
cands=[]
for k0 in range(N):
    lst=d.get(int(fp0[k0]))
    if lst:
        for k3 in lst: cands.append((k0,k3))
print("candidate (k0seed,k3seed) count:",len(cands))

def solve_keys(s0,s3):
    rk0=expand(s0);rk3=expand(s3)
    # per pair0 compute K1,K2 value, then verify constant across pairs
    K1=None;K2=None;ok=True
    for p in range(npairs):
        b0=int(B0[p]);lp=int(Lp_i[p]);clo=int(CLo[p]);b3=int(B3[p])
        B1=lp^F(b0^rk0)
        B2=clo^F(b3^rk3)
        k1=B1^Finv((B2^b0)&M)
        k2=B2^Finv((b3^B1)&M)
        if K1 is None:K1=k1;K2=k2
        elif k1!=K1 or k2!=K2: ok=False;break
    if not ok: return None
    Kr=[rk0,K1,K2,rk3]
    for p in range(npairs):
        if encrypt(pairs[p][0],Kr)!=pairs[p][1]: return None
    return Kr

sol=None
for s0,s3 in cands:
    r=solve_keys(s0,s3)
    if r: sol=(s0,s3,r);break
print("SOLUTION seeds k0,k3:",hex(sol[0]),hex(sol[1]))
Kr=sol[2]
print("round keys:",[hex(x) for x in Kr])

# recover seeds for K1,K2 too (invert expand)
inv={int(rk[i]):i for i in range(N)}
s1=inv.get(Kr[1]);s2=inv.get(Kr[2])
print("seeds:",hex(sol[0]),hex(s1) if s1 is not None else None,hex(s2) if s2 is not None else None,hex(sol[1]))

# decrypt
def decrypt(ct,Kk):
    right=(ct>>32)&M;left=ct&M
    left^=right
    for i in range(3,-1,-1):
        oldr=left
        oldl=(right^F(oldr^Kk[i]))&M
        right=oldr;left=oldl
    right^=left
    return ((left<<32)|right)&0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
# sanity: decrypt pairs
for pt,ct in pairs:
    assert decrypt(ct,Kr)==pt
print("all pairs decrypt correctly")

out=[]
for line in open('/app/ciphertexts.txt'):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line:continue
    ct=int(line)
    out.append(str(decrypt(ct,Kr)))
open('/app/plaintexts.txt','w').write("\n".join(out)+"\n")
print("wrote",len(out),"plaintexts")
